title: External Falsification and Replication

tests.acceptance: Both I3 teams submit valid derivations for all 14 exact-scope claims and no material objection survives blinded adjudication.
tests.failure: A reproducible in-scope contradiction, countermodel, or invalid proof step survives adjudication. Missing or inadequate derivations after 60 calendar days are NOT_REPLICATED without theorem refutation.
tests.invalid: Exposure, collusion, missing disclosure, or use of withheld material.

tests.acceptance: Both clean-room implementations agree with each other and the frozen expected result on every required item.
tests.failure: Any valid item mismatch survives adjudication. Missing outputs or the 60-day deadline missed also fail.
tests.invalid: Use of Project FAR implementation, checker, tests, oracle source, expected outputs, or another team's code.

tests.failure: Any overall or per-domain threshold is missed.
tests.invalid: Provenance failure, label leakage, or post-unblinding selection/replacement.
tests.source_frame: Frozen six-query arXiv v1 discovery procedure in the content-addressed protocol: complete date-bounded metadata, first 1000 per domain, deterministic cross-domain deduplication, at most first eligible worked finite example per paper, no replacement or source expansion. Supply sufficiency unestablished; incomplete strata invalidate intake.

tests.acceptance: Every valid in-scope material-loss case is flagged and every output is reported.
tests.failure: One valid in-scope ground-truth material-loss case is accepted as preserving or silently omitted.
tests.invalid: Missing custodian ground truth, broken seal, or out-of-scope case counted as a success.

tests.allocation: Frozen 24-reviewer cyclic allocation over 12 shuffled strata; 30 disjoint cases per arm per reviewer; Python 3.12 manifest-derived seed.
tests.primary: Pairwise material-disagreement rate relative to sealed custodian labels.
tests.failure: Effect, confidence, or safety margin is missed.
tests.missingness: Missing FAR pair = disagreement, missing standard pair = agreement; false-accept imputation FAR wrong / standard correct.
tests.eligibility: Consenting external non-author adults aged at least 18; English materials without translation; conforming existing environment; applicable ethics determination; fixed four-hour course and all 12 W4 classifications/witnesses correct across all six domains. No credential/experience/discipline discretion; first 24 by the frozen qualification order.

tests.primary: Blinded-adjudicated escaped material-defect rate under intention to treat.
tests.failure: Any benefit, site, or harm gate is missed.
tests.invalid: A site is lost, blinding is broken, allocation is non-reconstructable, or required screening log is absent.
tests.eligibility: Three independent routine documentary audit sites with existing single-auditor SOPs executable in the fixed English documentary interface within 60 minutes; reject mandatory team/peer/dual-control roles before enrollment. Next 40 eligible finite-record investigations per site within 180 days; exclude consequential live interventions.
tests.intervention_format: Both arms share native evidence/SOP and common outcome capture; only FAR adds exact W3 far-ir/2.0 fields and baseline report. U1 standard omits material sections 4 and 5. W5 far-ir/2.1 declarations excluded.
tests.worker_assignment: Existing consenting adult site auditors; frozen HD1 qualification/environment rules; first at most 40 qualifying within 30 days. Seal roster and cyclic worker (i-1) mod N for all 40 investigation indices before deriving arm allocation; no substitution or task swaps. Missing assigned-worker output remains an intention-to-treat defect.

tests.acceptance: Every coordinate passes and remains separately reported.
tests.failure: Any coordinate fails, is unavailable, or is replaced by a scalar aggregate.
tests.invalid: Broken measurement-ledger seal or provenance failure.

accounting.cost_summary: mean FAR minus mean standard per allocated case
accounting.attribution: Enrolled-person costs over their allocated tasks; U1 site-specific costs over its 40 investigations; only unassignable central U1 overhead in equal thirds across sites; HD1 common costs over 1440 ratings. Each entry once; no pooled redistribution of attributable U1 costs.

tests.median_algorithm: Sort all allocated arm observations numerically; odd n uses x[n//2], even n uses (x[n//2-1]+x[n//2])/2. Missing measurements fail. Exact rational arithmetic throughout, integer milliseconds floored once at capture; no threshold rounding.

essential_elements: declared comparison contract determines a behavior map
exact sufficiency iff behavior factors through the representation
behavior-kernel quotient is unique least-informative exact representation up to isomorphism
no simultaneous least-informative representation for all unrestricted observation contracts on a nontrivial domain
tests.acceptance: No qualifying pre-cutoff source teaches every essential element in combination; record only NOT_FALSIFIED_BY_REGISTERED_SEARCH.
tests.failure: One qualifying public pre-cutoff source teaches all four elements in combination and in the claimed arrangement; record FALSIFIED.
tests.falsifier: One qualifying public pre-cutoff source teaches all four elements in combination and in the claimed arrangement.
tests.invalid: Non-independent search, cutoff breach, missing query log, or incomplete required source class.
tests.search_method: Exact six queries, five required indexes, result limits, one-generation citation expansion, cutoff and 60-day stopping rules fixed in the content-addressed protocol.

registration_promotion: Final reviewed bytes of PR #470, before execution; pre-merge corrections are retained in PR history.

operational_rules.seed: int(input_manifest_sha256[:16], 16); Python 3.12 random.Random; separate allocation/analysis streams
operational_rules.adjudication: Three independent blinded adjudicators; at least two reproduce a valid witness; unresolved validity blocks acceptance; implementation defects remain failures.
